description: Source code for an Odoo report parser class 'account_analytic_journal' that generates analytic journal reports, including methods for retrieving and summing analytic lines and move lines based on date and journal filters.

classes.name: account_analytic_journal
classes.description: Parser class for generating analytic journal reports in Odoo, providing methods to retrieve and sum analytic and move lines based on journal and date filters.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report parser with context and updating local context with helper methods and modules.

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Retrieves move lines associated with a specific journal and date range.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Retrieves analytic lines associated with a specific move, journal, and date range.

methods.name: _sum_general
methods.description: Calculates the sum of debit minus credit for move lines within a journal and date range.

methods.name: _sum_analytic
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of analytic lines within a journal and date range.
